fixes: Full-tree audit found and migrated both remaining synchronous session-preparation calls in Earcons. All remaining actual Swift call sites now contain await.
Earcons caches unprepared AVAudioPlayer playback actions. AVAudioPlayer.prepareToPlay/currentTime/play now run only in the action after awaited InterfaceSoundPlayback session preparation.

Playback action rechecks enabled state, Task cancellation, latest feedback identity within its note/swish channel, take cancellation generation and a monotonic 150ms freshness bound immediately after preparation.
Note feedback and multiplier swishes use independent channels so a hit and a tier cue from the same update can both play. Newer same-channel feedback supersedes a queued older cue.
AudioService full suspension/interruption and metronome stop cancel pending Earcons feedback, preventing ended takes from emitting delayed sounds.
SongPlayback advances ContinuousClock.Instant with advanced(by:), preserving absolute timing and resolving the new shorthand_operator lint occurrence without modifying a baseline.
